constraints.name: fk_pt_matched_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, matched_order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: payment_transactions_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_payment_facts_immutability
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_payment_facts_immutability BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_payment_facts_immutability()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_payments
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_payments BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_payment_transactions
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_payment_transactions BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_payment_transactions_matched
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_payment_transactions_matched ON public.payment_transactions USING btree (company_id, matched_order_id) WHERE (matched_order_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_payment_transactions_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_payment_transactions_status ON public.payment_transactions USING btree (company_id, status, occurred_at DESC)

indexes.name: payment_transactions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_transactions_pkey ON public.payment_transactions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: uq_pt_company_provider_ref
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_pt_company_provider_ref ON public.payment_transactions USING btree (company_id, provider, provider_ref)
